children: I imagined the images at architectural scale, separated across multiple planes of glass. Individual fragments would occupy different depths so that the portrait could align from one position and begin to fracture as the viewer moved. The image would no longer be fixed. Where you stood would determine what you saw.

props.className: leading-[1.6] mb-0

children: At this scale the body becomes part of the work. A person approaching the installation sees one image; walking alongside it reveals another. Faces separate, overlap and momentarily reconnect. Reflections introduce people and architecture into the composition. Afternoon sunlight passes through the layers, projecting fragments onto the ground and changing the work again as the day moves.

children: The glass is therefore not simply a surface for displaying the image. It is part of the image.

children: For years these works existed only as compositions on a screen. Reconstructing the idea as an installation finally revealed the scale I had imagined for them. The portrait becomes less like an image and more like a piece of architecture — something that can be approached, walked around and experienced physically.

children: the more i look at it the more i realize why its so powerful. Its interesting to see how a computer randomly interprets a piece of cake, a girl and a dog eating cake.. and the best part for me is simply how simple the prompt was, just , a girl and a dog eating cake. This is thee mid journey, and over the last few years i have been unable to resist the shift of technology.. and now tools have become so powerful they are apparently escaping from the computers in which they were made. Well im not surprised.  Back to the point, which there is none .. the level of uncertainty is so extreme that its almost impossible to know whats next, or how difficult it is to maintain a singular direction.. I have to stay focused on the prompt .. the end result, and thi is often felt relatively quickly .. but sometimes longer and whats most astonishing is the fact that there are a an infinite number of possibilities when it comes to really pixels displaying a number of sets. I think strength is the most elegant
